import sys,ctypes,time,json,os
sys.path.insert(0,'/home/lhl/hipEngine-gemma4')
from hipengine.core.build import build_hip
from hipengine.core.hip import get_hip_runtime
from hipengine.core.memory import malloc,free
lib=build_hip(sources=['/tmp/priority_occupancy_control.hip'],family='priority_occupancy_control',profile='prefill',load=True,require_cached=os.environ.get('HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD')=='1')
lib.launch_occupancy_control.argtypes=[ctypes.c_void_p,ctypes.c_int64,ctypes.c_int64];lib.launch_occupancy_control.restype=ctypes.c_int
rt=get_hip_runtime();out=malloc(40*32*4)
try:
 for blocks in (1,1,40):
  rt.device_synchronize();start=time.perf_counter();assert lib.launch_occupancy_control(out.ptr,1000000,blocks)==0;rt.device_synchronize()
  print(json.dumps({'blocks':blocks,'waves':blocks,'threads':32,'ms':1000*(time.perf_counter()-start)}),flush=True)
finally:free(out)
observations: One-wave control yields MeanOccupancyPerCU 0.02498 against its 0.025 maximum; the active metric is about 1.0. Forty waves yield MeanOccupancyPerCU 0.9996 and an active metric of 2.0. The active metric appears WGP-normalized on this part.
Removing LDS conflict/stall counters from the group does not repair warm decode: MeanOccupancyPerCU 24.6 exceeds the whole-dispatch maximum of 128 / 40 = 3.2.

Warm decode GRBM_GUI_ACTIVE 461182 over 1.602 ms is inconsistent with first-decode 4356933 over 1.881 ms. Prefill 154819716 over 64.669 ms and 150946114 over 62.883 ms are consistent with about 2.4 GHz and MeanOccupancyPerCU 6.61 / 6.58.
Prefill estimates replicate across counter groups, but calibration of the control does not prove target-workload GRBM validity. Do not use derived percentages to assert a hard speed ceiling.
